messages.subject: htmlwidget displays locally but not on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

EBImage R package features an htmlwidget image viewer which I would like to use in shiny apps. The demo at https://github.com/aoles/EBImageDisplay runs fine locally, however, once deployed to https://aoles.shinyapps.io/EBImageDisplay/ the widget does not show up (the "Interactive browser" tab). I'm not sure why, any help is highly appreciated.

Thanks,
Andrzej
